How to use

Three steps,
three times a week.

CHERISH works best as a consistent ritual — the herbs need contact time to do their work.

01

Apply

Section your hair and apply oil directly to the scalp and lengths.

02

Massage

Gently massage in circular motions to boost circulation.

03

Leave & wash

Leave for at least one hour, or overnight, then wash with a mild shampoo.

Use 3 times a week for regular upkeep — if used daily, results are even better.
